programs.name: NVIDIA Ignite

source.note: Page confirms Ignite exists and its audience but states no dates. The live Workday job requisitions for the next Ignite cycle (e.g. paths like NVIDIA-2026-Ignite-Internships--Hardware-Engineering on nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com) could not be read: the standard job-detail URL returned an empty client-rendered shell, and the Workday CXS JSON API endpoint returned HTTP 403. Browser pass 2026-07-29: prior-cycle Workday requisition JR2005170 returns 'The page you are looking for doesn't exist', and a rendered search of the NVIDIA Workday board finds no live requisition titled Ignite — the program is between cycles. The ~October application window remains unverified (aggregator pattern only).
